name: Zhejiang EV-Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang EV-Tech Co.,Ltd. engages in research, development, production, sales, and technical services of new energy vehicle-mounted and non-vehicle-mounted products in China and internationally. It offers on-board chargers (OBC), on-board DC/DC converters, communication controllers (EVCC), smart electronic fuses (eFuse), integrated on-board power supply products, deeply integrated products, and other automotive products, such as liquid-cooled supercharging pile power module and intelligent DC charging pile power module. It also provides off-board charging systems. Zhejiang EV-Tech Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Huzhou, China.
